title: Garlic Crunch Tadka Nachos
description: A twist on classic nachos with the bold flavors of Mexican cuisine, featuring a crunchy topping and a pungent garlic sauce.
instructions: Arrange tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake for 5 minutes or until crispy.
In a small saucepan, heat the tadka over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Stir in the crunchy taco topping and cook for an additional minute.
Remove from heat and set aside.
In a large serving bowl, combine the baked tortilla chips, shredded cheese, and a spoonful of the garlic tadka mixture.
Top with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of cilantro, if desired.
Drizzle with lime juice and serve immediately.
